faq.a: Waheed is associated with the Arabic form وَحِيد, whose core sense is waheed; unique, alone.

faq.q: What is the origin of Waheed?
faq.a: Waheed is associated with Arabic. Waheed is Arabic وَحِيد (Waḥīd), meaning 'unique, alone'.
Yes — the underlying form وَحِيد is Arabic.
Waheed can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Waheed should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root و ح د is Quranic (oneness), but Waḥīd is not itself a Quranic personal name.
